required_transformations: Aggregate daily signup counts by city tier
Aggregate conversion rates by acquisition channel using converted_flag
Aggregate 7-day retention rates by cohort week using retained_7d_flag
Transform raw user data into aggregated KPI outputs only
justification: All business questions can be answered with aggregate outputs only, no raw user-level data needed
Minimum data principle: using only derived flags (converted_flag, retained_7d_flag) instead of raw timestamps
Password hash and auth token are credential materials that must never be released externally
Prefer derived KPI flags over raw behavior timestamps (retained_7d_flag over last_active_date)
